about: add-partner-love-theme D5: the partner theme's own Czech text. Czech only, never translated. Every series reference is tagged in lore and must be on tools/love-pack/lore-allowlist.json (CI: tools/love-pack/lint-theme-content.mjs). No plot, no pairings, no fates.
